context.why: Broaden the provenance handoff evaluation from a research-only frame to long-horizon enterprise and high-stakes professional workflows, using the Notion project hub and current public benchmarks while retaining research as one validation track.
rejected: Use research tasks as the sole paper and product frame — it underrepresents the commercial value of review-heavy enterprise, finance, legal, and healthcare artifact handoffs.
